questions.question: दासः + अस्मि — choose the correct sandhi form.
देवः + जयति — choose the correct sandhi form.
questions.explanation: अः before a घोष consonant becomes ओ.

questions.question: सन्तोषः + एव — choose the correct sandhi form.
questions.explanation: अः before a vowel other than अ loses the visarga.

questions.question: भक्ताः + आगच्छन्ति — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: आः before a vowel loses the visarga.

questions.question: मेघाः + वर्षन्ति — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: आः before a घोष consonant loses the visarga.

questions.question: मुनिः + भजते — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: After इ, visarga becomes र् before a घोष consonant.

questions.question: ऋषेः + अगस्त्यस्य — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: After a vowel other than अ/आ, visarga before a vowel becomes र्.

questions.question: हरिः + रक्षति — choose the correct sandhi result.
questions.explanation: Before र्, the inserted र् disappears and the preceding vowel lengthens.

questions.question: सः + अहम् — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: The special सः rule before अ gives ओऽ.

questions.question: एषः + आचार्यः — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: The special एषः rule before a sound other than अ drops the visarga.

questions.question: भोः + अर्जुन! — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: भोः before a vowel loses the visarga.

questions.question: भोः + कृष्ण! — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: भोः before an अघोष consonant retains the visarga.

questions.question: पुनः + अपि — choose the correct form.
questions.explanation: र्-स्थानिक विसर्ग restores र् before a vowel.

questions.question: रवेः + छविः — choose the correct form.
गङ्गायाः + तीरे — choose the correct form.
